definitions.full: H5615. sephorah [ סְפֹרָה ] noun feminine number ; — plural absolute סְפֹרוֺת יָדַעְתִּי לֹא Psa 71:15 I know not (the) numbers (of ׳י 's acts of righteousness and deliverance, i.e. they are innumerable ; compare ᵑ7 Symm.); > Du (after ᵐ5 B:ab ᵑ9 ᵑ6 א ) reads סְפָרוֺת (compare סִפְרָה above).
